# Knowledge Base API — operations

19 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `knowledge-base.create` — **Create a new FAQ inside knowledge base** — `POST /knowledge-bases/faqs` (write, location)
  Creates a new question-and-answer entry in a knowledge base.
- `knowledge-base.create-knowledge-base` — **Create a new knowledge base (max 15 knowledge bases per location)** — `POST /knowledge-bases/` (write, location)
  Creates a new knowledge base for a location (maximum 15 per location).
- `knowledge-base.delete` — **Delete an existing knowledge base FAQ** — `DELETE /knowledge-bases/faqs/{id}` (write, location)
  Permanently deletes one FAQ from a knowledge base.
- `knowledge-base.delete-file` — **Delete a file from knowledge base** — `DELETE /knowledge-bases/files/{fileId}` (write, location)
  Deletes one uploaded file from the authenticated location so the AI no longer uses it.
- `knowledge-base.delete-knowledge-base` — **Delete a knowledge base** — `DELETE /knowledge-bases/{knowledgeBaseId}` (write, location)
  Permanently deletes a knowledge base and its associated trained content.
- `knowledge-base.delete-trained-urls-for-knowledge-base` — **Delete trained pages** — `DELETE /knowledge-bases/crawler` (write, location)
  Removes trained website pages from a knowledge base so the AI no longer references them.
- `knowledge-base.discover-website` — **Start crawling and discover pages for training** — `POST /knowledge-bases/crawler` (write, location)
  Starts a website crawl that discovers pages for later AI training.
- `knowledge-base.get-all-website-urls-data-by-knowledge-base` — **Get all trained page links by knowledge base** — `GET /knowledge-bases/crawler` (read, location)
  Lists discovered and trained website pages for a knowledge base, with pagination and optional URL filter.
- `knowledge-base.get-crawling-status-for-latest-operation` — **Get crawling status for the latest operation** — `GET /knowledge-bases/crawler/status` (read, location)
  Fetches crawl/train progress for a specific operation, or the latest operation when operationId is omitted.
- `knowledge-base.get-file-by-id` — **Get file by id** — `GET /knowledge-bases/files/{fileId}` (read, location)
  Retrieves one uploaded file by id for the authenticated location.
- `knowledge-base.get-files-by-knowledge-base-public` — **Get all files by knowledge base** — `GET /knowledge-bases/files` (read, location)
  Lists files uploaded to a knowledge base, with optional pagination and name search.
- `knowledge-base.get-knowledge-base-by-id` — **Get knowledge base by ID** — `GET /knowledge-bases/{knowledgeBaseId}` (read, location)
  Retrieves one knowledge base by id, including name, metadata, and timestamps.
- `knowledge-base.get-sitemap-preview` — **Preview Sitemap URLs** — `POST /knowledge-bases/crawler/sitemap-preview` (write, location)
  Returns a paginated, searchable list of sitemap URLs without starting a crawl.
- `knowledge-base.list` — **Get all FAQs by knowledge base with pagination support** — `GET /knowledge-bases/faqs` (read, location)
  Retrieves Q&A entries for a knowledge base, with cursor or offset pagination and optional question search.
- `knowledge-base.list-all-knowledge-bases-paginated` — **Get all knowledge bases for a location by location Id (paginated)** — `GET /knowledge-bases/` (read, location)
  Lists knowledge bases for a sub-account (location), with optional name search and cursor pagination.
- `knowledge-base.train-discovered-urls` — **Train discovered website pages and ingest into the knowledge base** — `POST /knowledge-bases/crawler/train` (write, location)
  Queues selected discovered pages so the AI ingests their content into the knowledge base.
- `knowledge-base.update` — **Update an existing knowledge base FAQ** — `PUT /knowledge-bases/faqs/{id}` (write, location)
  Updates the question and/or answer of an existing FAQ.
- `knowledge-base.update-knowledge-base` — **Update a knowledge base** — `PUT /knowledge-bases/{id}` (write, location)
  Updates the name and/or description of an existing knowledge base.
- `knowledge-base.upload-file` — **Uploads a file to knowledge base (max file size: 10MB)** — `POST /knowledge-bases/files` (write, location, multipart)
  Uploads a PDF, DOC, or DOCX file (max 10MB) into a knowledge base for training.
